fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dull, hazy black paint with dust film on the rear hatch and tailgate area
Faded, chalky gray plastic on the rear bumper lower section
Dirt and grime along the lower doors and rocker panels on both sides
Light film and water spotting visible on the rear glass and side windows
Brake dust on the alloy wheels
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2009 Acura MDX. The black paint looks a bit dull and dusty in the photos, especially on the rear hatch, and the gray plastic on the rear bumper has faded. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a wash, buff and trim restoration so it photographs and shows better to buyers. Would you like a quote?
